notes.title: 🎉 Celebrate with Us: Epic Launch Sale! 🎉
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of our [u][b]first major RPG, Umbra: The Last Summoner! [/b][/u]

Dive into the mystical realms and epic battles right from the start: 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710560?utm_source=epidiscount


[h2]To make this launch even more spectacular, we're offering massive discounts on all our games during launch week![/h2] This is our way of celebrating with our incredible community — your support means the world to us.

[h2]Don't miss out on the excitement! [/h2]
Enjoy the special prices, and make sure to wishlist and explore the rich, captivating world of Umbra: The Last Summoner.
